en.text:
Grenade Ability usage refills 50% of your Magazine (rounded up) from reserves and changes the weapon's element to match your equipped Grenade Ability until stowed.

Magazine Refill cannot be triggered again without stowing the weapon first.

Kinetic weapons lose their Passive Damage Bonus against non-Boss PVE Combatants (10% on <primary/>Primary, 15% on <special/>Special).

Perks that replace your Grenade Ability (such as <solar/>Gunpowder Gamble or Transcendence Grenades) will also trigger Osmosis.
